subject.title: feat(agents): agent-owned gateway terminals with operator co-attach

question: Should an unsandboxed owner agent’s raw `terminal.input` bypass exec approval, or must terminal command input preserve exec approval or require a separate explicit opt-in?
rationale: The linked proposal treats input as RCE-class and expects approval or opt-in, while this PR intentionally makes it direct; only maintainers can define the permanent host-command trust boundary.

options.title: Preserve approval or explicit opt-in
options.body: Gate command-bearing terminal input through existing exec approval semantics or a separate per-agent permission while retaining direct read, resize, close, and co-attach behavior.

options.title: Accept direct terminal input
options.body: Intentionally treat terminal input as equivalent to unrestricted exec, document that contract, and add live proof covering disable and ownership boundaries.

recommendation.title: Preserve approval or explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Gate command-bearing terminal input through existing exec approval semantics or a separate per-agent permission while retaining direct read, resize, close, and co-attach behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the umbrella proposal and merged adjacent screen-control phase, making them the best available owner for the terminal trust-model decision.
